from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCategorization(BaseModel):
    """One document with its identified cause of action."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this legal document (e.g., 《判决文书 1》)")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) identified for this document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of document (e.g., 民事判决书, 行政再审审查裁定书, 刑事赔偿申诉审查决定书)")
    parties_involved: list[str] = Field(description="Names of parties/entities mentioned in the document (plaintiffs, defendants, government agencies, etc.)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_categorizations: list[DocumentCategorization]
